bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money for county feedlot program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; COUNTY FEEDLOT PROGRAM.

$2,950,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,950,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for grants to delegated counties to administer the county feedlot program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116.0711, subdivisions 2 and 3. Money remaining after the first year is available the second year.
additions: $2,950,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,950,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for grants to delegated counties to administer the county feedlot program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116.0711, subdivisions 2 and 3. Money remaining after the first year is available the second year.
